edges.reason: mintFRENS reads the paused state variable in its require guard.
mintFRENS compares the mint amount against maxFRENMintAmount.
mintFRENS checks totalSupply plus amount against maxFREN.
mintFRENS performs cost * _FRENMintAmount multiplication for the payment check.
mintFRENS calls nextToken inside the mint loop to obtain a token id.

msg.sender (via _msgSender) is used as the mint recipient and payment sender in mintFRENS.
